summary: Wing Yip Food Holdings Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting that Chairman Xiantao Wang purchased 18,355 ordinary shares on KOSDAQ on August 5, 2026, at KRW 1,148 (~US$0.81) per share, raising his stake to 16.08%. He also disclosed a trading plan with the Korea Exchange to acquire up to 219,178 shares between September 7 and October 6, 2026, at an expected price near KRW 1,159 per share, potentially increasing ownership to 17.82%. This is an insider open-market accumulation under Korean rules, not a formal tender or issuer buyback. Watch for further stake increases or potential strategic moves.
